visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside an indoor space featuring a wooden shoe rack filled with footwear, a young man wearing a black hoodie and a black beanie reacts with intense emotion, laughing while tears stream down his face as he holds a cardboard sign. (2) The scene cuts to a hallway where a group of young people, primarily female, are standing in a line against a wall decorated with event posters. They are dressed in casual sweaters and jackets, singing with focused expressions. (3) A medium shot captures a girl in a pink jacket singing with her eyes partially closed, surrounded by other students who are also harmonizing. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The camera pans and zooms slightly to highlight different members of the vocal group, showing their micro-expressions of concentration and passion. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (5) The group continues their performance in a synchronized manner, with their hands occasionally moving to their chests or gesturing slightly to the rhythm. (6) The video returns to the young man from phase one; he is now wiping his eyes with his sleeve and holding his hand to his mouth, visibly moved to tears while the students in the background begin to clap and smile at him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy laughter and overlapping chatter from multiple voices fill the acoustic space, with a dominant male voice expressing excitement. (2) A sudden transition to pure a cappella choral singing occurs. The vocals are rich and resonant, with a clear female lead supported by deep harmonic textures from other singers. (3) The vocal intensity swells as the choir reaches a melodic peak; the voices are perfectly blended with high spectral purity and emotional warmth. (4) A percussive transient of rhythmic clapping and cheering breaks the singing, accompanied by a sharp transition SFX. (5) A male voice speaks with noticeable vocal strain and high pitch variability, his tone sounding choked with emotion as he describes a physical sensation of awe while background chatter continues.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents an emotional encounter between a host and a group of indigenous students performing an a cappella song. The primary goal is to showcase the raw vocal talent and spiritual power of the students' music, which is so moving that it brings the adult host to tears, creating a heartwarming and authentic connection through song.
